description: Send reminder texts at the right time after the clock change. Done means all three clinic time zones get on-time reminders in staging and in one live clinic.

decision.source: Clinic report forwarded by Erin Bennett
decision.text: Three clinics saw reminders arrive an hour late after the clock change; the reminder job uses a fixed time offset.

details: Next: Josh Reed ships the fix and Megan checks the three clinic time zones in staging.
Numbers: about 3 missed appointments per affected clinic a week; three clinics reported on 2026-03-09 and one on 2026-03-06.
